اسبغللت (form IVq)
# اِسْبَغْلَلْتُ (isbaḡlaltu) /is.baɣ.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْبَغَلَّ (isbaḡalla)
# اِسْبَغْلَلْتَ (isbaḡlalta) /is.baɣ.lal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْبَغَلَّ (isbaḡalla)
# اِسْبَغْلَلْتِ (isbaḡlalti) /is.baɣ.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْبَغَلَّ (isbaḡalla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
